title: 第27章 这里是魔的陨落之地
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
“孟婷，你在看什么？”

    孟婷收回视线，脸上挂着清淡的笑容。

    “没什么！姑姑。”

    “那就随我拜见智源大长老！”

    “好！”

    修真界七大世家，每一家都依附了一个宗门。

    其中孟家最为突出，因为青云宗的绯月尊者就是孟家人。

    因为这一缘故，孟家在所有世家里也是排名靠前的。

    至于为什么不是第一或者第二，那是因为孟家底蕴不够，在所有修真世家里，孟家是起势最晚的。

    他们的老祖也不过是问鼎修为。

    孟绯云带着孟婷上前与智源长老见礼，但从头到尾都没提及顾念念，更没有给顾念念见面礼，反而提到了程玲。

    “本来这次带队的是我那侄媳妇，可她自青云宗回去之后便是一病不起，她那个弟弟是她心头肉，如今……哎！”

    智源大长老并不接话，只是微笑扶着胡须。

    一时之间气氛有些尴尬。

    孟绯云眸光一转，自己又笑了。

    “这次天渊秘境还是要劳烦贵宗照应一二了。”

    智源大长老这才点了点头。

    “应该的！”

    孟绯云这才领着孟婷走了。

    其他六家倒是不受影响，只是暗地里怎么想的就不知道了。

    倒是顾念念又收了一波礼。

    星元扒拉着那些东西，嗤笑。

    “到底是大世家，比起那些所谓宗门可就大气得多了。”

    送的虽然都不是什么大宝贝，但是都是值钱的宝贝，这就够了。

    顾念念自己也很满意。

    从来了修真界她都没有自己的小金库，当然那些在矿产上得到的灵石不算，那些是修炼资源，不能算钱。

    但是眼前这些不一样了，白来的都是钱啊。

    她很高兴。

    这样的场合桃夭和小六不适合出现，免得引起不必要的麻烦，而且他们两个也算是底牌，当然要藏一藏了。

    这会儿都躲在顾念念的储物袋里。

    见到塞进来这么多东西，桃夭和小六也是两眼放光。

    这时，一道清冷的声音从半空中传来。

    “时辰已到，准备开启秘境！”

    说话的是一位白衣男子，手持法杖，周身气势凛然，乃是四大宗门之一瑶光宗的沉越长老。

    星元贴着顾念念的耳朵解释：“这位原是我们青云宗的长老，千年前不知道因为什么去了瑶光宗。”

    顾念念垫着脚去看前面。

    智源大长老已经飞身前去，与其他几个宗门的长老们，各站四个方位。

    四人的灵力汇聚于一处，虚空中顿时浮现出一道巨大的光门。
content_en:
"Meng Ting, what are you looking at?"

    Meng Ting looked away with a light smile on her face.

    "Nothing! Auntie."

    "Then follow me to meet the Great Elder Zhiyuan!"

    "Okay!"

    Each of the seven major families in the world of cultivation is attached to a sect.

    Among them, the Meng family is the most prominent, because Venerable Feiyue of the Qingyun Sect is the Meng family.

    For this reason, the Meng family ranks high among all aristocratic families.

    As for why it is not first or second, it is because the Meng family does not have enough foundation. Among all the cultivation families, the Meng family is the latest to rise in power.

    Their ancestors only aspired to the highest level of cultivation.

    Meng Feiyun and Meng Ting came forward to meet Elder Zhiyuan, but they never mentioned Gu Niannian from beginning to end, let alone gave Gu Niannian a meeting ceremony. Instead, they mentioned Cheng Ling.

    "Originally, my niece-in-law was leading the team this time, but she has been ill since she returned to the Qingyun Sect. Her younger brother is her heartthrob. Now...hey!"

    Great Elder Zhiyuan did not answer, just smiled and held his beard.

    The atmosphere was a little awkward for a while.

    Meng Feiyun turned her eyes and smiled again.

    "This time the Tianyuan Secret Realm still has to trouble your Lord to take care of it."

    Great Elder Zhiyuan nodded.

    "It should!"

    Meng Feiyun then led Meng Ting away.

    The other six families were not affected, but I don’t know what they were thinking secretly.

    Gu Niannian, on the other hand, received another wave of gifts.

    Xingyuan pulled those things and sneered.

    "After all, it is a big family, and it is much more grand than those so-called sects."

    Although the gifts are not big treasures, they are valuable treasures, and that is enough.

    Gu Niannian herself was also very satisfied.

    She had never had a small treasury of her own in the world of cultivation. Of course, the spiritual stones obtained from minerals did not count. Those were cultivation resources and could not be counted as money.

    But these things are different in front of me. All the money is free.

    She was very happy.

    It was not appropriate for Taoyao and Xiaoliu to appear on such an occasion, so as not to cause unnecessary trouble. Moreover, they were considered trump cards, so of course they had to hide them.

    At the moment, they are all hiding in Gu Niannian's storage bag.

    Seeing so many things stuffed in, Taoyao and Xiaoliu's eyes lit up.

    At this time, a cold voice came from mid-air.

    "The time has come, prepare to open the secret realm!"

    The man who spoke was a man in white, holding a staff and having an awe-inspiring aura. He was Elder Shen Yue of Yaoguang Sect, one of the four major sects.

    Xingyuan leaned into Gu Niannian's ear and explained: "This was originally an elder of our Qingyun Sect. He went to the Yaoguang Sect a thousand years ago for unknown reasons."

    Gu Niannian put her feet up and looked ahead.

    Great Elder Zhiyuan has already flown forward, standing in four directions with the elders of several other sects.

    The spiritual powers of the four people gathered in one place, and a huge light door suddenly appeared in the void.
title_en: Chapter 27 This is the place where the devil fell
